why_ai: Ad serving and measurement software with no licence; AI-native platforms can replicate most of it.
why_clarity: Impressions recur by the million, but whether an ad was heard stays unverifiable.
why_digital: Telemetry, ad files and dashboards are fully digital; enterprise deals sold remotely.

why_ai: Buyers pay for a referee independent of sellers; credibility and governance cannot be automated.
why_clarity: Causation from hearing an ad has no ground truth to check against.
why_digital: IP matches and conversion logs in, attribution reports out, all on screens.

why_ai: Audio understanding is commodity; AI models will score creative directly.
why_clarity: Creative quality rests on convention and taste with promo codes as weak feedback.
why_digital: Ad audio files analysed and scored entirely in software, sold remotely.

why_ai: Transcripts exist and language models judging suitability are a commodity.
why_clarity: Every episode classified the same way, though suitability thresholds vary by brand.
why_digital: Transcripts in, suitability labels out, delivered through platform APIs.

why_ai: A tractable modelling problem on telemetry platforms already hold; software does it.
why_clarity: Listening curves give a well-posed probability target checked against streaming completion data.
why_digital: Session telemetry in, modelled exposure out, all inside platform systems.

why_ai: Value rests on host credibility and brand-host relationships, though the workflow mechanises.
why_clarity: Brief, script, read and airing steps repeat per deal and airing is verifiable.
why_digital: Scripts, recordings and verification are digital; deals run on relationships over email.

why_ai: A ranking and allocation problem that optimisation software solves directly.
why_clarity: Millions of slot decisions with yield as a measurable objective.
why_digital: Ad server decisions made and delivered in milliseconds by software.

why_ai: Inventory forecasting is well-posed and replaceable by forecasting software.
why_clarity: Forecasts are checked against actual impressions within weeks.
why_digital: Download data in, forecasts and prices out, handled by remote yield teams.

why_ai: Monthly reconciliation across two systems is mechanical and automatable.
why_clarity: Same reconciliation and unified report every month with checkable totals.
why_digital: Ad server exports and spreadsheets in, client reports out.

why_ai: Accreditation and advertiser trust matter, but the telemetry modelling is automatable.
why_clarity: Downloads count precisely, but whether listens reached the ad goes unverified.
why_digital: Telemetry and attribution data processed and reported entirely in software.

why_ai: Serving hosts means pricing and negotiating endorsements, partly relationship-based talent work.
why_clarity: What an endorsement is worth has no agreed measure or method.
why_digital: Platform evidence and rate analysis delivered online to creators.
